name: Personal GTD action-item capture and prioritization tool

mentions.name: Personal GTD action-item capture and prioritization tool
mentions.description: This tool sits on top of the user's existing tools and gives a unified "What do I need to do (now/today)?" view. It auto-captures action items from meeting transcriptions and other inbound inputs, routes quick thoughts to the right tool with a couple of keystrokes, and helps prioritize the day to keep the GTD loop running despite back-to-back meetings and context-switching. LLM support for task breakdown may be added as human-in-the-loop assistance.
mentions.problem: Drowning in meetings and scattered tools, with back-to-back meetings and context-switching making it hard or impossible to stay on top of what needs to be done.
mentions.source_excerpt:
